sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

items.prompt: A model needs 3.2 vans. How many are required?

steps: Three vans leave some load uncarried, so four are needed.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A repair service charges a $130 call-out fee plus $11 per hour. A job cost $229 in total. Which equation determines the number of hours h?
The formula A = -3bh − 3 models a design constraint, where A, b, and h are positive. Solve it for h.
Item A costs $9 each and item B costs $25 each. You may spend at most $360 in total. Which inequality expresses this constraint on the counts a and b?
A tank holds 245 litres and is filling at 18 litres per minute. After how many minutes does it hold 677 litres?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: A budget model allows 12.7 units of a product sold individually. How should this solution be interpreted?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A repair service charges a $60 call-out fee plus $15 per hour. A job cost $210 in total. Which equation determines the number of hours h?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
